purpose: Primary-source audit for squarefull values of the balancing/Pell Lucas sequence U_n(6,1), valuation lifting, primitive divisors, balancing-Wieferich primes, and the elliptic-divisibility alternative

sources.title: On the Numerical Factors of the Arithmetic Forms alpha^n +/- beta^n
sources.author: R. D. Carmichael
sources.archive_note: JSTOR Early Journal Content scan obtained through Internet Archive; the scan is the original article, with pages arranged two-up after the repository cover.

sources.title: A Simple Proof of Carmichael's Theorem on Primitive Divisors
sources.author: Minoru Yabuta
sources.archive_note: Official Fibonacci Quarterly scan. Theorem 1 restates and reproves Carmichael's positive-discriminant primitive-divisor theorem.

sources.title: The p-adic valuation of Lucas sequences
sources.author: Carlo Sanna
sources.archive_note: Official Fibonacci Quarterly PDF. Theorem 1.5 and Corollary 1.6 are the valuation-lifting inputs used in the report.

sources.title: A brief remark on balancing-Wieferich primes
sources.author: Utkal Keshari Dutta, Bijan Kumar Patel, and Prasanta Kumar Ray
sources.archive_note: Journal-hosted PDF. It defines balancing-Wieferich primes and records 13, 31, and 1546463 as the conjectured examples known in the cited computation; this is not a completeness theorem.

sources.title: On square factors of terms of binary recurring sequences and the ABC Conjecture
sources.author: Paulo Ribenboim
sources.archive_note: Journal-hosted original. Proposition 2.21 and its strengthening 2.22 are explicitly conditional on abc.

sources.title: Primitive divisors of elliptic divisibility sequences
sources.author: Graham Everest, Gerard McLaren, and Thomas Ward
sources.archive_note: Author arXiv version. It records Silverman's eventual primitive-divisor theorem and proves explicit bounds for selected elliptic families.

sources.title: Perfect powers in elliptic divisibility sequences
sources.author: Maryam Nowroozi and Samir Siksek
sources.publication: Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society 56(11) (2024), 3331-3345
sources.archive_note: Author arXiv version. The paper separates fixed-exponent perfect-power finiteness from the still harder varying-exponent problem; neither statement is a theorem about all squarefull terms.

sources.title: Lucas non-Wieferich primes in arithmetic progressions and the abc conjecture
sources.author: K. Anitha, I. Mumtaj Fathima, and A. R. Vijayalakshmi
sources.archive_note: Author arXiv version of the later journal article. The lower bound for Lucas non-Wieferich primes in arithmetic progressions assumes abc over number fields and does not give one at every rank.

related_existing_or_metadata_only.title: Existence of Primitive Divisors of Lucas and Lehmer Numbers
related_existing_or_metadata_only.author: Yuri Bilu, Guillaume Hanrot, Paul M. Voutier; appendix by Maurice Mignotte
related_existing_or_metadata_only.publication: Journal fuer die reine und angewandte Mathematik 539 (2001), 75-122

related_existing_or_metadata_only.title: The ABC Conjecture and the Powerful Part of Terms in Binary Recurring Sequences
related_existing_or_metadata_only.author: Paulo Ribenboim and Gary Walsh
related_existing_or_metadata_only.archive_note: Publisher metadata and abstract verified; no additional local full-text copy is claimed.

related_existing_or_metadata_only.title: Wieferich's criterion and the abc-conjecture
related_existing_or_metadata_only.author: Joseph H. Silverman
related_existing_or_metadata_only.archive_note: Publisher metadata verified; cited only for context on the abc/Wieferich direction.

related_existing_or_metadata_only.title: The ABC-conjecture and the powerful numbers in Lucas sequences
related_existing_or_metadata_only.author: Minoru Yabuta
related_existing_or_metadata_only.archive_note: Official Fibonacci Quarterly PDF already archived elsewhere in the repository; Theorem 2.3 is explicitly conditional on abc.
